rga_fa18_inb.description: Residual current-dependence correction for Fa18 Inb when production acceptance uses only the 50 nA MC sample. Data fit: R_data(I) = b_d + m_d I with b_d = 0.0276884777 and m_d = -0.0000702640, corresponding to relative data slope -0.2537662628 +/- 0.0196421015 (% per nA). MC fit: epsilon_mc(I) = b_m + m_m I with b_m = 0.0605858529 and m_m = -0.0000957095, corresponding to relative MC slope -0.1579733848 +/- 0.0016897544 (% per nA). Because cross_sections.cpp uses acceptance from the 50 nA MC only, the stored factor is epsilon_resid(I) = epsilon_data_rel(I) / epsilon_mc_rel(50 nA), not epsilon_data_rel(I) / epsilon_mc_rel(I). Here epsilon_data_rel(I) = 1 + slope_data * I / 100 and epsilon_mc_rel(50) = 1 + slope_mc * 50 / 100 = 0.9210133076. cross_sections.cpp then applies 1 / epsilon_resid(I), which multiplies the extracted cross section by epsilon_mc_rel(50) / epsilon_data_rel(I).
